title: distephanus plumosus
intro: Distephanus plumosus, commonly known as African lavender tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Distephanus plumosus include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote sleep, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Distephanus plumosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
